# DONGSHENG® Fire Equipment — lianfafire.com

> Fujian Nanan Sheng Xin Lian Fa Fire Equipment Factory (DONGSHENG®) is a Chinese manufacturer of fire hoses and firefighting equipment, located in Nan'an, Fujian. We export to Southeast Asia, South America and the Middle East.

## Company facts

- Daily production capacity: over 50,000 meters of hose
- Experience: 15+ years manufacturing fire hoses and agricultural water belts
- Full in-house chain: spinning → weaving → extrusion → hardware → assembly
- Brand: DONGSHENG® (registered trademark)
- Official Alibaba store: https://lianfafire.en.alibaba.com/

## Contact

- Email: lianfafire@163.com
- WhatsApp: +86-18606051302
